Firewall level
In lax mode, firewall allows all outbound connections and rejects unknown incoming connections but acknowledges presence of the gateway.
In low mode, firewall allows all outbound connections and silently drops unknown incoming connections.
In high mode, firewall allows outgoing connections to HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, POP3, IMAP, SSH services and silently drops unknown incoming connections.
In user mode, individual firewall rules may be configured as well as the default behavior.
Firewall default behavior
Answer only these selected Internet IPv4 pings

EnabledSource IPicmp-type
The outgoing policy defines what is done with packets coming from the LAN devices toward the internet. Setting it to REJECT or DROP will forbid any internet traffic from the LAN unless explicitly allowed by a firewall rule.
The incoming policy defines what is done with packets destined to the gateway. They can be either REJECTED (the gateway will notify the sender they were rejected) or DROPPED (the gateway will silently discard those packets).
